title: A following camera
description:
Make the camera follow the player with a dead zone and stay inside the world.

```
world 2000x1000, view 800x450
player (400, 300): camera does not move (inside the dead zone)
player (700, 300): camera moves right to keep it in the zone
player near the world's right edge: camera stops at the edge
```
hints: With a dead zone half-width of 100: `if (px > cam.x + 100) cam.x = px - 100;` and the mirror for the left (lesson 4.01).
Clamp the centre: `cam.x = std::clamp(cam.x, viewW / 2, worldW - viewW / 2);`.
requirements: The camera's target is the centre of the view; the dead zone is a box around the centre.
Move the camera only by how far the player is outside the dead zone.
Clamp the camera so the view never shows outside the world.
stretch: Smooth the movement with `cam.x += (target - cam.x) * 5 * dt`.
